analysis.purpose: Persists dossiers as sharded, atomically-written files whose staleness is anchored to a content hash, so a rebuild touches one file and a crash never leaves a partial artifact.
responsibilities: Write each dossier atomically to a sharded path
Detect staleness from the source node hash and schema version
Prune artifacts whose source node no longer exists

businessRules.rule: Writes are atomic, so a crash never leaves a half-written artifact.
businessRules.rationale: A truncated cached artifact would be served as if it were whole.

businessRules.rule: Staleness is anchored to a content hash rather than a timestamp.
businessRules.rationale: Timestamps change without the content changing, and vice versa.
